fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects listing of the inodes of the "/" directory to determine if the we are running inside of a container.
fields.name: Potential Container Discovery Via Inodes Listing
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/ls" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " /" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " / ") and tgt.process.cmdline matches "(?:\\s-[^-\\s]{0,20}i|\\s--inode\\s)" and tgt.process.cmdline matches "(?:\\s-[^-\\s]{0,20}d|\\s--directory\\s)"))
